description.value: Dumpling King (大东方饺子王) is a Chinese restaurant in Richmond, BC specializing in traditional dumplings and Chinese cuisine. Located in a unit at 7911 Alderbridge Way, it is situated in one of Richmond's densely served dining corridors. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond would find it a convenient stop for a hot, filling meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The URL discovered for this record (dumplingking.ca) resolves to a Dumpling King franchise in Markham, Ontario (phone 905-209-9888, address 5328 HWY7 EAST, MARKHAM), which is entirely different from the Richmond, BC OSM record. The discovered URL appears to be a false positive from the pipeline (medium confidence). No authoritative website for the Richmond location is available, so all amenity answers rely solely on OSM tags, which confirm only the restaurant category and Chinese cuisine type.
concerns: Discovered URL (dumplingking.ca, medium confidence) resolves to a completely different Dumpling King location in Markham, Ontario (phone 905-209-9888, address 5328 HWY7 EAST UNIT 1A, MARKHAM). This URL does not represent the Richmond, BC location and should not be used as the business website.
No authoritative website for the Richmond location could be identified; OSM only provides a menu link (website:menu: https://dumplingking.zomi.menu/) rather than a full website tag.
All amenity fields are null because the only fetchable website belongs to a different location and the OSM tags contain no amenity detail beyond restaurant/cuisine.
